subject: Media Literacy
title: Health Misinformation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Health Misinformation.

hook.text: A viral post claims lemon water cures cancer. It was shared 2 million times. Patients delayed real treatment.

buildup.text: Health misinformation includes fake cures, anti-vaccine claims, and distorted medical research.

discovery.text: The WHO called it an 'infodemic' — health misinformation spreading alongside the actual pandemic.

twist.text: Health misinfo is especially dangerous because it leads to real-world harm — delayed treatment and vaccine refusal.

climax.text: When a false health claim goes viral, the consequences aren't just informational. They're medical.

punchline.text: A viral health tip can heal no one and harm millions.

quiz.question: What did the WHO call the spread of health misinformation during the pandemic?
